== Acquisition ==
'''[[Signet of Capture]]'''
* [[Ryk Arrowwing]] ([[Mineral Springs]])

== Notes ==
* If a preparation is activated while under the effect of this stance, the preparation will still benefit if this stance ends before you finish activation.
* The only non-elite preparations with a shorter duration than recharge are [[Rapid Fire]] (if Marksmanship is below 5), [[Choking Gas]], and [[Seeking Arrows]].
